smyx-fish-isolation-detection-analysis 1.0.0

- Initial release supporting continuous 2D tracking of individual fish in aquarium video feeds using fixed cameras.
- Automatically detects and alerts on prolonged isolation behavior (over 10 body lengths from centroid for more than 1 hour, configurable).
- Differentiates between isolation types and supports multi-level alerting strategies for early disease or stress detection.
- Considers species-specific behavior, physiological isolation contexts, and tracking reliability to reduce false alarms.
- Integrates with smart aquarium cameras; outputs detailed daily reports and real-time reminders to prompt user intervention.
- Enforces secure open-id acquisition before processing or historical queries; all historical data is fetched from cloud API only.
